title: STLTH Loop Closed Pod Vape Device
description:
Description
Warranty
Crafted meticulously to cater to adult smokers seeking sustainable and cost-effective alternatives, the STLTH Loop Device is a testament to practicality in everyday life. It redefines conventional disposable products.
Browse all Loop flavours!
An astonishing feature of the STLTH Loop device is its remarkable 600mAh rechargeable battery, elevating the vaping experience by offering extended longevity. Paired with the groundbreaking STLTH Loop and Vice Loop Pod collections, featuring disposable vape pods with a large e-Liquid capacity, this device ensures an advanced vaping journey.
In terms of aesthetics, the STLTH Loop Device boasts a captivating elegant metal finish with a sophisticated and trendy appearance. This device seamlessly combines style with functionality, featuring an activation and battery indicator for an intuitive vaping experience. Retaining the signature sleek design associated with STLTH products, this device not only meets but exceeds expectations, setting a new standard of excellence in both design and performance.
600 mAh rechargebale battery.
Battery LED indicator.
Direct draw firing mechanism.
Please recycle when empty at a proper recycling depot.
Warranty
30 DAYS. NO HASSLES. GUARANTEED. YES, YOU READ THAT RIGHT.
We doubt you’ll have any problems with your purchases; however, we understand mistakes and oversights can happen. Sometimes it’s a manufacturing defect, poor battery life, or you just don’t like what you’ve paid for. No problem. For a period of 30 days from your purchase you can exchange your device for a new one or receive a FULL in-store or online credit. Physical damages to products void all warranties, express or implied.
DEVICE & DISPOSABLE WARRANTY CONDITIONS
To have a valid warranty claim on a device or disposable vape device, you must keep the product packaging/outer sleeve which contains the proof of purchase and authentication stickers. We cannot warranty devices or disposable vape devices without their original packaging.
